subject: test(ssh_dotnet): fix Connect tests to construct InterfaceControl (6 failing -> passing)
body:
test(ssh_dotnet): fix Connect tests to construct InterfaceControl (6 failing -> passing)

The six ProtocolSshDotNet Connect_* tests set protocol.InterfaceControl.Info directly,
assuming Initialize() creates the InterfaceControl -- but it doesn't (the connection
framework builds it via `new InterfaceControl(parent, protocol, info)`). They threw a
NullReferenceException before Connect() ever ran.

Construct the InterfaceControl the same way the framework does (with a throwaway Panel
parent). Connect() now actually executes and the assertions hold: null/empty
hostname/username return false + State=Error, and a localhost connection failure leaves
State=Error -- confirming the decomposed Connect()'s graceful handling. All 7 pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Not applicable. Our fork does not use the SshDotNet protocol or library, so these tests and files do not exist in our codebase.
